SELECT MIN(kt.kind) AS movie_kind, MIN(t.title) AS complete_us_internet_movie  
FROM (  
    SELECT t.id, t.title, t.kind_id, t.production_year, mi.movie_id, mi.info_type_id, mi.info, mi.note  
    FROM title AS t  
    JOIN movie_info AS mi ON t.id = mi.movie_id  
    JOIN info_type AS it1 ON it1.id = mi.info_type_id  
    WHERE mi.note LIKE '%internet%'  
    AND mi.info IS NOT NULL  
    AND it1.info = 'release dates'  
    AND t.production_year > 1990  
) AS filtered_movies  
JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON filtered_movies.movie_id = mc.movie_id  
JOIN company_name AS cn ON mc.company_id = cn.id  
JOIN company_type AS ct ON mc.company_type_id = ct.id  
JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON filtered_movies.movie_id = mk.movie_id  
JOIN keyword AS k ON mk.keyword_id = k.id  
JOIN complete_cast AS cc ON filtered_movies.movie_id = cc.movie_id  
JOIN comp_cast_type AS cct1 ON cc.status_id = cct1.id  
JOIN kind_type AS kt ON filtered_movies.kind_id = kt.id  
WHERE cn.country_code = '[us]'  
AND cct1.kind = 'complete+verified'  
AND kt.kind IN ('movie', 'tv movie', 'video movie', 'video game')  
AND filtered_movies.info LIKE 'USA:% 199%'  
OR filtered_movies.info LIKE 'USA:% 200%'
